title: Reverse proxy choice: caddy default (matching a common Linux-host baseline that already runs Caddy), traefik alternative for docker-label auto-discovery, none for tunnel-fronted projects (elicited)
context: Compose stacks need a reverse-proxy for HTTPS termination and hostname-to-service routing. Caddy is the shipped default, matching a common Linux-host baseline that already runs it. Traefik has a docker-label auto-discovery model some projects prefer. Some projects front their stack only with the Cloudflare-tunnel sibling and skip a reverse proxy inside compose.
decision: The reverse-proxy choice is elicited via the reverseProxy parameter. The shipped default is caddy. The alternatives are traefik (for projects that want docker-label auto-discovery) and none (for projects fronted only by the Cloudflare-tunnel sibling). Standards trace clause: Caddy docs AND Traefik docs.
consequences: A project applying reverseProxy=caddy gets the caddy/Caddyfile artefact and the caddy reload verb. A project applying reverseProxy=traefik gets the traefik/traefik.yaml artefact and the Traefik equivalent reload verb; docker-label auto-discovery is a project-side pattern the guide names. A project applying reverseProxy=none omits the reverse-proxy service and must apply the edge-cloudflare-tunnel sibling so ingress terminates at the CF edge.
